$comment: Canonical machine-readable brand facts for Pirates of Tokyo Bay. This file is the source of truth for how our name, our shows and our language are described anywhere. If a caption, a press article, an AI answer or a partner page disagrees with this file, this file is right.

name.ja: パイレーツ・オブ・東京湾
name.note: The Japanese name keeps 東京湾 because the group is named after a place, not transliterated as a whole.

award.name: Peatix Community Award 2026: Creative Arts Community
award.nameJa: Peatixコミュニティアワード2026 クリエイティブ・アートコミュニティ賞
award.detail: Selected from more than 250 communities nationwide.

description.en: Pirates of Tokyo Bay is an English and Japanese improv comedy group in Tokyo. Monthly shows in Ebisu, plus corporate training and workshops across Japan.
description.ja: パイレーツ・オブ・東京湾は、東京を拠点とする日本語と英語の即興コメディグループです。恵比寿で毎月公演を行い、企業研修やワークショップも提供しています。

approvedPhrasing.ja: 日本語と英語で楽しめる即興コメディ

bannedTerms.reason: Sets the wrong expectation. It suggests the audience needs both languages. Our shows are built so you only need one.
Same reason as the English term.
bannedTerms.useInstead: 日本語と英語で楽しめる即興コメディ

barrierRemovalPhrasing.ja: 英語がわからなくても楽しめる

language.orderingRule: In Japanese content, always write 日本語 before English. Example: 日本語と英語で楽しめる即興コメディ, never 英語と日本語で.
language.numberFormatting: Use half-width numbers in Japanese text. Correct: 2,500円（1ドリンク付）. Wrong: ２，５００円（１ドリンク付）.
language.punctuation: Do not use em-dashes in any copy. Use 'to' for number ranges.

totalPerformed.basis: Numbered main-show series reached #169 on 2026-08-30, verified against ticketing records (#153 was 2025-03-30; 16 consecutive monthly shows since, with no December 2025 show). Plus 44 overseas tour, festival and one-off gigs and 28 extra English-only and Japanese-only monthly shows from 2013 to 2015, both itemised in shows/attendance-history.csv. Plus online shows and private and corporate shows from internal records, which are not yet itemised. Replaces the older 450+ figure.
totalPerformed.updateRule: Recheck once a year. Current cadence adds roughly 15 to 25 shows per year. The numbered series can be recounted from shows/show-history.csv, which is now current to 2026-08.

shows.linkingRule: Always link to /shows for ticket information. Never link directly to /tickets, which redirects off-domain and leaks link equity. Email calls to action may use a direct purchase URL.

lengthMinutes.note: Add a 10 minute break if the show runs longer than 45 minutes.

venue.name: What the Dickens!

address.ja: ROOB6ビル 4F, 恵比寿西1-13-3, 渋谷区, 東京都 150-0021

access.en: 3-minute walk from JR Ebisu Station, 1 stop from Shibuya
access.ja: JR恵比寿駅から徒歩3分（渋谷から1駅）

venue.napNote: Ebisunishi has no hyphen. This spelling must match Google Business Profile exactly.

font.note: Modern sans-serif that covers Japanese and English, so both languages look unified across devices.

design.colorInspiration: The festive parties of Mardi Gras.
design.voice: Simple but not simplistic, fun but not too funny.

sameAs: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/パイレーツ・オブ・東京湾

assets.note: Large binary assets live in Google Drive, not in this repository.
